ACME PRIVATE LIMITED - COMPLIANCE POLICY DOCUMENT
Companies Act, 2013 Compliance Framework

1. ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING (AGM)
As per Section 96 of the Companies Act, 2013, we shall conduct our Annual General Meeting within 6 months from the financial year end. The AGM was held on 15 September 2024 with proper notices sent to all shareholders. Minutes were maintained and filed.

2. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS FILING
In compliance with Section 137 of the Companies Act, 2013, we file Form AOC-4 within 30 days of the AGM. Our audited financial statements for FY 2023-24 are prepared and will be filed with the MCA within the prescribed timeline.

3. ANNUAL RETURN
As required under Section 92 and Rule 11 of the Companies (Management and Administration) Rules, 2014, we file Form MGT-7 within 60 days of the AGM. The annual return contains accurate shareholding patterns and compliance disclosures.

4. DIRECTOR KYC COMPLIANCE
All directors have completed their DIR-3 KYC as mandated by Rule 12A of the Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules, 2014. The KYC was submitted before 30 September 2024 deadline.

5. AUDITOR APPOINTMENT
Following Section 139 and Rule 4 of the Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014, we ratified our statutory auditor appointment in the AGM and filed Form ADT-1 within 15 days.

6. DEPOSITS RETURN
Under Rule 16 of the Companies (Acceptance of Deposits) Rules, 2014, we file Form DPT-3 by 30 June annually, even though no deposits were accepted during the financial year.

7. MSME COMPLIANCE
In accordance with the Companies (Furnishing of information about payment to micro and small enterprise suppliers) Order, 2019, we prepare Form MSME-1 half-yearly for outstanding payments to MSME suppliers. The return for Apr-Sep period is due by 31 October.

8. CORPORATE SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY
As our company meets the thresholds under Section 135 of the Companies Act, 2013, we have established a CSR committee and will file Form CSR-2 as per Companies (Corporate Social Responsibility Policy) Rules, 2014.

9. BOARD MEETINGS AND RESOLUTIONS
We maintain proper board meeting records and file necessary forms with MCA as required.

10. COMPLIANCE MONITORING
We have established internal controls to ensure ongoing compliance with all applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 and related rules.
